_doc: Per-host rules for wayback.host_get. Alan, 2026-11-02 21:50 UTC (end of scripts/world-law/COVERAGE-WAVE.md): no pacing caps of our own. Every host gets ONE request in flight machine-wide and the next as soon as the last one answers, with no daily limit; only the site's own rules slow it down. Keys: exact host, the host without 'www.', or '*.parent.domain'. tier A = a rate the publisher states (give 'interval' seconds or 'rate' requests/s, and 'source'); tier C = bot management known (informational: one in flight, never more); stop = never request this host. 'concurrency' (1-8, default 1) allows that many requests in flight, only for documented public APIs that state no limit and show no bot management; a 429/503/time-out drops it to 1 until the throttle recovers, and any bot-management sign forces 1 for good. 'daily' is no longer read. Always applied on top: a slower robots Crawl-delay, Retry-After, halving with a 30 s pause on 429/503/time-out, and a permanent stop on any challenge (stop file in %LOCALAPPDATA%/gitlaw/host-stops).
